data.claim: An idempotent operation satisfies f(f(x))=f(x) where repeated application converges to the same state as a single application. A safe operation merely guarantees that retries do not violate system invariants without necessarily producing identical state. An append-only event log requires safety of its writers, not idempotency, because appending is inherently non-idempotent; the log survives at-least-once delivery via deterministic operation identifiers or deduplication keys.
